summary: Code-orchestration POST/PUT/PATCH calls keep their read intent (Codex gocli1219-r4 P2): codeOrchInvoke dispatches every write-method call through codeOrchSendWrite, which takes the *Query* client methods (PostQueryWithParams, PostQueryWithParamsAndHeaders, the PUT/PATCH siblings, and the multipart Query siblings) when the call is not gated, i.e. reachable through conduyt-crm_read. The intent is !gated: NeedsConfirm comes from the generator's read-command classifier (endpointIsReadCommandShared), the same one that sets the direct CLI's IsReadOnly / mcp:read-only and makes it emit PostQueryWithParams; the resolved-path check can only raise it to gated. So dashboards.run.post-dashboards-id and dialer.get-token reach doInternal with readOnlyIntent=true. Gated calls (mutations by intent) keep Post/PostWithHeaders/PostMultipartWithHeaders and the PUT/PATCH equivalents exactly as before, so the r4 keyed no-reuse rule is untouched. client.go gains PostQueryMultipartWithParamsAndHeaders, mirroring PutQueryMultipartWithParamsAndHeaders, so every dispatched shape has a Query sibling.
reason: r4 routed all code-orchestration POSTs through Post/PostWithHeaders, so the two read-only POSTs were verify-mode short-circuited, lost safe retries, used the mutation transport and invalidated the response cache, unlike the direct CLI.
validated_outcome: TestCodeOrchWriteMethodFollowsIntentForEveryEndpoint walks all 974 endpoints (461 POST/PUT/PATCH; 2 read by intent go to Query, 459 to the mutation methods, with and without headers) and cross-checks every one against the direct CLI command's mcp:read-only for the same method and path. TestCodeOrchReadIntentPOSTRunsInVerifyMode, ...RetriesATransientFailure and ...DoesNotInvalidateTheCache (both endpoints through conduyt-crm_read) fail with the r4 routing and pass; TestCodeOrchMutationPOSTKeepsMutationIntent (contacts.create through conduyt-crm_execute: verify short-circuit, no retry, cache evicted) passes on both.
